mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pathways to the body was most worthwhile because it showed what the balance organs actually help do: steady a view and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two finished balance organs felt mostly like assembly; the result added less explanation than building either organ.

surprise.text: I was interested that the weighted membranes respond both to head tilt and to starting straight-line motion.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though combining the two organs mainly followed the goal rather than explaining why they had to be joined first.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the separate parts connect to a familiar action made me curious about what the body model might do next.
